title: Doha heat leads TTF/Henry Hub ratio
hypothesis: R2 | [gas-lng] Doha maximum temperature 20d z-score > 1.5 (Gulf cooling demand diverts cargoes) leads the TTF to Henry Hub ratio by 2 days (+); trade long TTF=F 4d [weather.doha.temp_max -> finance.ratio.ttf_henryhub]
message: Not supported: Doha temp_max vs TTF/HH ratio r=0.008 (n=387, best lag 6d r=-0.054, perm p n.s.); trade rule 34 trades, hit 65%, excess -0.9pp overall, pre-war excess -2.9pp, war-test +2.0pp (n=14); actionability 5.35 - likely regime artifact, not a rule

trade_idea.entry_rule: weather.doha.temp_max rolling_zscore_20d > 1 at close -> long ratio:ttf_henryhub next session
trade_idea.exit_rule: close after 6 trading days (no overlapping entries)
trade_idea.caveats: Backtest on daily closes, no costs/slippage; few independent regimes; signal and target may share the war as common cause.

followup_hypothesis: R2 | [gas-lng] Houston maximum temperature 20d z-score > 1.0 (US cooling demand lifts Henry Hub, the denominator) leads the TTF to Henry Hub ratio by 3 days (-); control for the Doha-heat result, trade short TTF/HH ratio 3d [weather.houston.temp_max -> finance.ratio.ttf_henryhub] (parent: R2-0027)
